was in the spotlight on Wednesday as UBS started coverage on the neocloud computing firm with a Buy rating and a $120 price target.

“Despite outstanding AI compute demand signals and strong evidence that CoreWeave's revenue per GW metric will march higher, Street sentiment is very cautious (reflected in the 2027 revs multiple of just 3x revs),” analyst Karl Keirstead wrote in a note to clients. “We respect the concerns (primarily leveraged/credit risk) but conclude that they're peaking and hence we are making a non-consensus positive call with a Buy rating.”

Delving deeper, Keirstead said there are risks that investors will continue to “play defense” in less AI-exposed stocks, but the company has established a reputation for reliability and performance, which should separate it from its peers. “A positive call on CoreWeave shares is a de facto call that investors will soon rotate back into the long-AI trade, a scenario that seems increasingly likely given the muted sentiment, strong demand signals and reported frontier lab growth,” Keirstead added.

title: CoreWeave in spotlight as UBS starts coverage with Buy rating
